# Policy claim: Made in Italy

## Allowed
- "Made in Italy" for products assembled in Montebelluna: Dolomiti, Cresta, Nevaio boots and Rifugio merino socks and base layers.
- "Designed in Italy" / "Disegnato in Italia" for Sentiero, Torrente, Vetta, Bosco, Passo and Baita, which are produced in Vietnam and Romania on Italian designs.

## Forbidden
- "Made in Italy", "Italian made" or the Italian flag on any product of the second group, in titles, copy, feeds or ads.
- "Handmade" unless the product is in the heritage range.

## Notes
The English title experiment showed a strong CTR effect of "Made in Italy"; the temptation to extend it to other lines is explicitly rejected. Legal basis: Italian law 166/2009 and the EU origin marking rules. Checked by legal on every category title change.
